I can't tell you how people reacted in the mailboxes, because I can't search or read the emails here and don't have any of that day's messages to quote. Anything I said about specific employees' emails would be a guess.

From general public record rather than the store, Jeff Skilling announced his resignation as CEO on 2001-08-14, citing personal reasons. Ken Lay resumed the CEO role. Press coverage and later testimony describe widespread surprise and concern about the timing, and Sherron Watkins's warning memo to Lay followed within days.

To see the actual reaction, you would want to read mail dated 2001-08-14 and the days just after, starting with Lay's and Skilling's own mailboxes, executive assistants, and the trading and finance groups. I'm not able to confirm what any of those contain.
